title: data for message.received
description: A message from a contact (direction=inbound, origin=customer) or, on coexistence channels, an echo of a message sent from the WhatsApp Business App (direction=outbound, origin=business_app). Never auto-reply unless direction=inbound AND origin=customer.

type.description: `interactive_reply` (since v0.14.0): the contact tapped a template quick reply button or answered an interactive message; see `reply`. New types may be added; treat unknown values as unsupported.

kind.description: template_quick_reply: quick reply button of a template (Meta type=button); button_reply/list_reply: reply to an interactive message.

id.description: Button payload (template quick reply) or the reply/row id (interactive).

title.description: Text the contact saw and tapped.

context.description: Message the contact replied to (Meta context.id): quoted replies and button clicks.

message_id.description: Meshio id when the replied message belongs to this integrator.

template_name.description: Template of the replied message, when it was a template.

contact_name.description: WhatsApp profile name of the contact when provided by Meta.

imported.description: True for messages from coexistence history sync (best effort); do not treat as new.
